verdict.rationale: Warp is an HR and payroll product, so configuring multiple pay schedules across teams is an applicable axis. The evidence pack never documents pay schedules, pay frequencies (weekly, biweekly, semimonthly, monthly), or assigning schedules to teams. Scheduled automation jobs and shift scheduling are different features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can set up multiple pay schedules (weekly, biweekly, semimonthly, monthly) across different teams
